title: VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-01 — "You live out of it" — BUILT v1

cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-01 — "YOU LIVE OUT OF IT" — BUILT V1

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: BUILT AND EXPORTED 8/22. 1080x1920, 30fps CFR, 35.69s, -15.0 LUFS. Girls-trip micro-angle: on a girls weekend there is nowhere to put your things, so the bag never gets unpacked, it gets lived out of. The claim: your bag is your dresser, so it has to stand open on its own. VO = ElevenLabs v3 Creative preset, "Woman Over 40" voice, one continuous take. Cut entirely from the existing light chocolate library plus the live PDP recordings. FORMAT CHANGE FROM PLAN: no over-40 greenscreen creator exists, so v1 is a faceless product-montage VO like the shipped Margot / pack / fit / build ads. The over-40 direction is carried by the voice. Every beat, timing and law is otherwise unchanged.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: On a girls trip you live out of your bag,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: lc-travel-S11, in at 1.0s. Light chocolate bag on the floor at the foot of a made bed, guest room, daylight.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Recognition. She has slept next to this exact setup four times this year.

HOOK. Bag on screen from frame one.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: so bring one that stands open on its own.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: askme-ELEANOR-S11, in at 0.5s. Bag open and packed, flap folded back, standing on its own.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
The verdict, shown not said.

The whole angle in one image.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Eleanor Weekender from Velantra.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: lc-travel-S04, in at 1.5s. Closed bag front-on, still.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Plain fact.

Mandatory intro lands at 4.6s. Caption ASR burned "Vellen tra" and was corrected by hand to Velantra.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's fully structured, smooth leather fold-over flap,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: askme-ELEANOR-S06, in at 0.8s. Macro across the leather and the folded flap edge.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Tactile.

Attribute stack beat 1.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: brass hardware,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: askme-ELEANOR-S05, in at 1.0s. Turn lock and clasp plate macro.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Weight and finish.

Short 1.3s beat, cuts on the word.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: no logo anywhere on it,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: lc-travel-S05, in at 5.0s. Slow move across blank leather and canvas weave.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Quiet proof. Nothing to read on it.

The no-logo fact is mandatory and it gets its own frame.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: so it keeps its shape packed full or half empty.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: askme-ELEANOR-S12, in at 0.4s. Bag open and packed full, sides holding square.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Structural payoff.

This is the beat the whole angle rests on.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I took mine to Charleston in June and never actually unpacked,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: lc-travel-S12, in at 1.0s. Bag set down by a door with a coat nearby, arrival.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Lived-in. Day one of the trip.

PROOF beat. First person, time-stamped.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: it just sat open by the bed for three days.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: lc-travel-S08, in at 1.0s. Open bag on the bed, rolled clothes visible, caramel leather interior.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Relief. She always knew where it was.

Interior is caramel leather with the caramel slip pocket. Correct on this clip.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Three days of clothes, shoes, toiletries,

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: packvo-seg_01, in at 6.0s. Hands loading items into the open bag.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Concrete. Nouns, not adjectives.

Clip carries its own VO in the source. Muted at -60 dB like every other video item.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and it still goes in the overhead bin.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: lc-travel-S09, in at 1.0s. Bag sitting on a rolling carry-on.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Settled. Nothing gets checked.

Last b-roll beat before the PDP run.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It comes in four colors, three ship now.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: pdp-swatches screen recording at 0.61x. Real swatch row, four colorways.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Neutral fact.

Black is an all-leather PRE-ORDER shipping mid September, which is why the line says three ship now. Never say four without that clause.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: They're running a sale right now, and the colorways go fast.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: pdp-price screen recording at 0.86x. Real $209.99 struck to $159.99, Save $50.00.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Soft urgency, factual only.

Verified live 8/22. No invented countdown or stock number.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I left the link below.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: pdp-cart screen recording at 1.17x. Scroll into the real Add to Cart.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Flat. No performance.

CTA. Last beat is always the live PDP.
NOTES

cards.title: DELIVERED
cards.text: VEL-WEEKENDER-GS-LIVEOUT-01-v1.mp4 in the Weekender video folder. 1080x1920, 30fps CFR, 35.69s, 1068 frames, -15.0 LUFS, true peak -4.2 dBFS. Editable timeline lives in ChatCut as LIVEOUT-01 v1.

cards.title: FORMAT CHANGE, FLAGGED
cards.text: The concept specced a greenscreen creator PiP. There is no over-40 creator in the existing greenscreen avatar set, so v1 is a faceless product-montage VO, the format of the shipped Margot / pack / fit / build ads. The over-40 direction is carried by the voice. Putting a creator on screen needs a new over-40 greenscreen avatar generated first.

cards.title: VO
cards.text: ElevenLabs eleven_v3, Creative preset (stability 0.0), similarity 0.85, speaker boost on, voice Woman Over 40. One continuous full-length take, never per-line. Three takes generated, take 2 picked on the word-level STT brand gate. TTS input used the Vell-Ahn-Trah respelling; the script keeps the plain spelling.

cards.title: LOUDNESS
cards.text: The raw take landed at -29.7 LUFS with only -9.1 dBFS of peak, so a timeline gain trim would have clipped. Normalized to -14 LUFS / -1.5 TP before import instead.

cards.title: COLORWAY, IMPORTANT
cards.text: The NB-* library clips are the BLACK all-leather colorway, which is the pre-order. The whole cut is built on light chocolate footage so the ad is not selling a bag that ships mid September.

cards.title: CAPTION AUDIT 1
cards.text: Scribe ASR burned the brand as "Vellen tra". Corrected by hand to Velantra. Every other card was checked against the script and matched. Weekender came through spelled correctly.

cards.title: CAPTION AUDIT 2
cards.text: At stroke 3 the last three cards were nearly illegible white-on-white over the PDP screen recording. Stroke raised to 7 at full opacity plus a shadow, re-rendered and re-checked on frames 880 and 1050.

cards.title: CAPTION SPEC
cards.text: Word-timed off the VO track only. 26 cards, 3-11 words each, max 32 characters, single line, bottom-center. Inter 700 at 0.055 of the short edge, white with a black stroke.

cards.title: AUDIO HYGIENE
cards.text: Every video item muted at -60 dB. packvo-seg_01 and the askme clips carry their own spoken VO in the source and none of it leaks in.

cards.title: NO KEN BURNS
cards.text: Zero frozen stills in this cut. Every one of the 14 beats is moving footage or a real screen recording.

cards.title: STILL OPEN
cards.text: The :30 cutdown in the concept doc is written but not built. Say the word and it is a trim of this same timeline.
